name: Luida no Himitsu Nikki
original_name: ルイーダのヒミツ日記
source:
For the sake of her liquor lodge, Luida has been working at a suspicious location, where various men come to grope her body and she surrenders to pleasure...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061742.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
为了维持自己的酒馆，Luida一直在一个可疑的地方工作。各色男人前来抚摸她的身体，而她也渐渐沉溺于快感……

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE061742.html]DLsite英文版[/url]）
